summary: District Metals Corp., a junior mineral exploration stage company, acquires, explores, and evaluates mineral resource properties. It explores for lead, zinc, silver, copper, molybdenum, cobalt, yttrium, and other rare earth elements. The company was formerly known as MK2 Ventures Ltd. and changed its name to District Metals Corp. in July 2019. District Metals Corp. was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
ceo: Mr. Garrett Paul Ainsworth B.Sc., BSC (HONS), BTECH (HONS), DIPTECH, P.Geo.
